data.reportText: Suncor Energy  Inc. Common Stock is estimated to report earnings on  11/03/2026. Our vendor, Zacks Investment Research, might revise this date in the future, once the company announces the actual earnings date. data.heading: SU Earnings Date

text: SU has a "high" Earnings Quality Ranking (EQR) for the 91st consecutive week. Earnings quality refers to the extent to which current earnings predict future earnings. "High-quality" earnings are expected to persist, while "low-quality" earnings do not. EQR is a weekly ranking of relative earnings quality for a large universe of publicly traded US equities. Companies are compared to peers in their industry. Find out more about EQR data.
